name: GetYouTubeTranscript
description: YouTube transcripts for people, AI assistants and developers. Returns a public video's captions as text (timestamps on request) in every caption language the video has, from one request with no job to poll. REST API, remote MCP server (https://getyoutubetranscript.com/api/mcp), Python and JS SDKs, a Chrome extension and a web tool. 100 free credits on sign-up, paid plans from $5/month.
